title: Maintenance Gaps
description: Leased aircraft's runs of days without flights (aircraft_maintenance_gaps): how often and how long they are out of service, and how long they operate between service gaps (to spot missed servicing), by model, age and aircraft. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime) flown in the run of flying days before each gap. A gap is a run of consecutive days on which the aircraft completed no BTS-reported flight (days with only cancelled flights count as gap days), so it is an inferred maintenance, storage or schedule period, not a recorded one. Only gaps that ended are included: an aircraft still out of service at the end of the data has no row for that last gap. Built by matillion/aircraft-maintenance-days.tran.yaml.

list.name: catalog
list.label: Catalog
list.description: The Unity Catalog catalog holding the faa schema. scripts/grafana-provision.sh sets it from databricks.catalog.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number ORDER BY 1

list.name: min_gap
list.label: Service gap (days)
list.description: A gap of at least this many days counts as a service opportunity and ends an operating period; shorter gaps are left out of the gap panels. One-day gaps are mostly aircraft that don't fly on a given weekday.

list.name: limit_hours
list.label: Hour limit
list.description: Airborne hours an aircraft may fly between service gaps; longer operating periods are flagged.

list.name: tail
list.label: Aircraft
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT g.Tail_Number FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: leased tail numbers for the selected models

panels.title: Operating before a service gap (hour limit ${limit_hours} h, service gap ${min_gap}+ days)
Periods
panels.description: An operating period runs from the end of one service gap (a gap of at least the 'Service gap' number of days) to the start of the next; shorter gaps inside it don't end it. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime). Periods whose service gap starts in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Now over
panels.description: Aircraft that have flown more than the hour limit since their last service gap, as of the end of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count_if(hours > ${limit_hours}) FROM (SELECT l.Tail_Number, l.make_model, l.service_end, datediff(CAST($__timeTo AS DATE), l.service_end) AS days_since,
        count(DISTINCT o.FlightDate) AS flying_days, max(o.FlightDate) AS last_flight, sum(o.AirTime) / 60 AS hours
   FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, max(maintenance_end) AS service_end FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g
         WHERE days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND maintenance_end < CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2) l
   JOIN ${catalog}.faa.ontime o ON o.Tail_Number = l.Tail_Number AND o.FlightDate > l.service_end
        AND o.FlightDate <= CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND o.Cancelled = 0
   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4)

panels.title: Hours flown before each service gap
panels.description: An operating period runs from the end of one service gap (a gap of at least the 'Service gap' number of days) to the start of the next; shorter gaps inside it don't end it. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime). Each point is one operating period, placed on the day its service gap began; red points went past the hour limit (dashed line). Servicing done overnight, without losing a day's flying, leaves no gap and can't be seen in this data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(gap_from AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
       CASE WHEN hours <= ${limit_hours} THEN hours END AS `Within limit`, CASE WHEN hours > ${limit_hours} THEN hours END AS `Over limit`,
       ${limit_hours} AS `Limit`
FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Operating periods by hours flown
panels.description: An operating period runs from the end of one service gap (a gap of at least the 'Service gap' number of days) to the start of the next; shorter gaps inside it don't end it. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime). Number of periods in each band of airborne hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS Hours, count(*) AS Periods FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN hours < 100 THEN '<100' WHEN hours < 250 THEN '100-250' WHEN hours < 500 THEN '250-500'
              WHEN hours < 750 THEN '500-750' WHEN hours < 1000 THEN '750-1k' WHEN hours < 1500 THEN '1k-1.5k'
              WHEN hours < 2500 THEN '1.5k-2.5k' ELSE '2.5k+' END AS b
  FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE))
GROUP BY b ORDER BY array_position(array('<100', '100-250', '250-500', '500-750', '750-1k', '1k-1.5k', '1.5k-2.5k', '2.5k+'), b)

panels.title: Share of operating periods over the limit, by model
panels.description: Per model with at least 20 operating periods in range, worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT make_model AS Model, round(100 * count_if(hours > ${limit_hours}) / count(*), 1) AS `Over limit %`
FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY make_model HAVING count(*) >= 20 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Flying now: hours since last service gap
panels.description: Every aircraft that flew after its last service gap, as of the end of the time range, most hours first. Hours come from the BTS flights (AirTime of completed flights). Servicing done overnight, without losing a day's flying, leaves no gap and can't be seen in this data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Tail_Number AS Tail, make_model AS Model, CAST(service_end AS STRING) AS `Last service gap ended`,
       days_since AS `Days since`, flying_days AS `Flying days`, round(hours) AS `Hours since`,
       CASE WHEN hours > ${limit_hours} THEN round(hours - ${limit_hours}) END AS `Over limit by`, CAST(last_flight AS STRING) AS `Last flight`
FROM (SELECT l.Tail_Number, l.make_model, l.service_end, datediff(CAST($__timeTo AS DATE), l.service_end) AS days_since,
        count(DISTINCT o.FlightDate) AS flying_days, max(o.FlightDate) AS last_flight, sum(o.AirTime) / 60 AS hours
   FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, max(maintenance_end) AS service_end FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g
         WHERE days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND maintenance_end < CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2) l
   JOIN ${catalog}.faa.ontime o ON o.Tail_Number = l.Tail_Number AND o.FlightDate > l.service_end
        AND o.FlightDate <= CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND o.Cancelled = 0
   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4)
ORDER BY hours DESC

panels.title: Operating periods over the limit
panels.description: An operating period runs from the end of one service gap (a gap of at least the 'Service gap' number of days) to the start of the next; shorter gaps inside it don't end it. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime). Every period longer than the hour limit, longest first. 'First in data' marks periods that start at the aircraft's first flight in the data, so they may have started earlier. Servicing done overnight, without losing a day's flying, leaves no gap and can't be seen in this data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Tail_Number AS Tail, make_model AS Model, CAST(run_from AS STRING) AS `Operating from`, CAST(last_flight AS STRING) AS `Last flight`,
       cal_days AS `Days`, flying_days AS `Flying days`, round(hours) AS `Hours flown`, round(hours - ${limit_hours}) AS `Over limit by`,
       CAST(gap_from AS STRING) AS `Service gap from`, gap_days AS `Gap days`, CASE WHEN first_in_data THEN 'yes' END AS `First in data`
FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND hours > ${limit_hours}
ORDER BY hours DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Aircraft
panels.description: Leased aircraft with at least one gap starting in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT Tail_Number) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Gaps
panels.description: A gap is a run of consecutive days on which the aircraft completed no BTS-reported flight (days with only cancelled flights count as gap days), so it is an inferred maintenance, storage or schedule period, not a recorded one. Only gaps that ended are included: an aircraft still out of service at the end of the data has no row for that last gap. Built by matillion/aircraft-maintenance-days.tran.yaml. Gaps starting in range, at least the minimum length.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Days out
panels.description: Total aircraft-days in the gaps that start in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(days_in_maintenance) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Median gap
panels.description: Half the gaps are this long or shorter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile(days_in_maintenance, 0.5) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Average gap
panels.description: Mean gap length; pulled up by long storage periods.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(days_in_maintenance) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Days flying
panels.description: Average run of consecutive flying days before a gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(days_with_flights) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Hours flying
panels.description: Average airborne hours (BTS AirTime) flown in the run of flying days before a gap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(total_hours) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Hours / day
panels.description: Airborne hours per day on which the aircraft flew.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT try_divide(sum(total_hours), sum(days_with_flights)) FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)

panels.title: Aircraft out of service per day
panels.description: How many of the selected aircraft were in a gap on each day, with a 7-day average. The 2020 rise is the COVID-19 parking of fleets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, n AS `Out of service`, avg(n) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7-day average`
FROM (SELECT CAST(day AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, count(DISTINCT Tail_Number) AS n FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, explode(sequence(maintenance_start, maintenance_end)) AS day FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_end >= CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND maintenance_start <= CAST($__timeTo AS DATE))
      WHERE day BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) GROUP BY 1)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Gaps by length
panels.description: Number of gaps in each length band. Most are one day: aircraft that don't fly on a given day of the week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS Days, count(*) AS Gaps FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance = 1 THEN '1' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 7 THEN '4-7'
              WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 14 THEN '8-14' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 30 THEN '15-30'
              WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 90 THEN '31-90' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 365 THEN '91-365' ELSE '365+' END AS b
  FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE))
GROUP BY b ORDER BY array_position(array('1', '2-3', '4-7', '8-14', '15-30', '31-90', '91-365', '365+'), b)

panels.title: Days out of service by gap length
panels.description: Aircraft-days in each length band: a few long gaps account for most of the time out of service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS Days, sum(days_in_maintenance) AS `Aircraft-days` FROM (
  SELECT days_in_maintenance, CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance = 1 THEN '1' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 3 THEN '2-3' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 7 THEN '4-7'
              WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 14 THEN '8-14' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 30 THEN '15-30'
              WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 90 THEN '31-90' WHEN days_in_maintenance <= 365 THEN '91-365' ELSE '365+' END AS b
  FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE))
GROUP BY b ORDER BY array_position(array('1', '2-3', '4-7', '8-14', '15-30', '31-90', '91-365', '365+'), b)

panels.title: Gaps by day of week they start
panels.description: Which weekday the first day out of service falls on. A peak on one day means aircraft regularly sit out that day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_format(maintenance_start, 'E') AS Day, count(*) AS Gaps FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY Day, dayofweek(maintenance_start) ORDER BY (dayofweek(maintenance_start) + 5) % 7

panels.title: Gaps per month
panels.description: Gaps starting each month, split into short (up to 3 days), medium (4 to 30) and long (over 30).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_format(maintenance_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS Month,
       count_if(days_in_maintenance <= 3) AS `Up to 3 days`,
       count_if(days_in_maintenance BETWEEN 4 AND 30) AS `4-30 days`,
       count_if(days_in_maintenance > 30) AS `Over 30 days`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Models
panels.description: Per registered make and model. Availability = flying days / (flying days + gap days) over the gaps starting in range; Gaps/ac-yr = gaps per aircraft per year of the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT make_model AS Model, count(DISTINCT Tail_Number) AS Aircraft, max(seats) AS Seats, round(avg(year_mfr)) AS `Avg year built`,
       count(*) AS Gaps,
       round(try_divide(count(*), count(DISTINCT Tail_Number) * greatest(datediff(CAST($__timeTo AS DATE), CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE)), 1) / 365.25), 1) AS `Gaps/ac-yr`,
       round(avg(days_in_maintenance), 1) AS `Avg gap (d)`, max(days_in_maintenance) AS `Longest (d)`,
       round(try_divide(sum(days_in_maintenance), count(DISTINCT Tail_Number))) AS `Days out/ac`,
       round(avg(total_hours)) AS `Avg hrs between gaps`, round(try_divide(sum(total_hours), sum(days_with_flights)), 1) AS `Hrs/flying day`,
       round(try_divide(100 * sum(days_with_flights), sum(days_with_flights + days_in_maintenance)), 1) AS `Availability %`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY make_model ORDER BY Aircraft DESC

panels.title: Availability by model
panels.description: Flying days as a share of flying plus gap days, models with at least 5 aircraft, lowest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT make_model AS Model, round(try_divide(100 * sum(days_with_flights), sum(days_with_flights + days_in_maintenance)), 1) AS `Availability %`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY make_model HAVING count(DISTINCT Tail_Number) >= 5 ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Average gap by year built
panels.description: Mean gap length by the aircraft's year of manufacture.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(CAST(year_mfr AS STRING), 'Unknown') AS `Year built`, round(avg(days_in_maintenance), 1) AS `Avg gap (d)`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY year_mfr ORDER BY year_mfr NULLS LAST

panels.title: Average gap by hours flown before it
panels.description: Mean gap length by the airborne hours flown in the run of flying days before the gap: do longer runs end in longer gaps?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS `Hours flown before`, round(avg(days_in_maintenance), 1) AS `Avg gap (d)` FROM (
  SELECT days_in_maintenance, CASE WHEN total_hours < 50 THEN '<50' WHEN total_hours < 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN total_hours < 250 THEN '100-250'
              WHEN total_hours < 500 THEN '250-500' WHEN total_hours < 1000 THEN '500-1k' ELSE '1k+' END AS b
  FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE))
GROUP BY b ORDER BY array_position(array('<50', '50-100', '100-250', '250-500', '500-1k', '1k+'), b)

panels.title: Longest gaps
panels.description: The 25 longest gaps starting in range, with the flying run before each.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Tail_Number AS Tail, make_model AS Model, year_mfr AS `Year built`, CAST(maintenance_start AS STRING) AS `Out from`,
       CAST(maintenance_end AS STRING) AS `Out to`, days_in_maintenance AS `Days out`, CAST(start_date AS STRING) AS `Flying since`, days_with_flights AS `Days flying before`, round(total_hours) AS `Hours before`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
ORDER BY days_in_maintenance DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: All aircraft
panels.description: Every aircraft with gaps starting in range; click a header to sort.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Tail_Number AS Tail, make_model AS Model, max(year_mfr) AS `Year built`, count(*) AS Gaps,
       sum(days_in_maintenance) AS `Days out`, round(sum(total_hours)) AS `Hours flown`, round(avg(total_hours)) AS `Avg hrs between gaps`, round(avg(days_in_maintenance), 1) AS `Avg gap (d)`, max(days_in_maintenance) AS `Longest (d)`,
       round(try_divide(100 * sum(days_with_flights), sum(days_with_flights + days_in_maintenance)), 1) AS `Availability %`,
       CAST(max(maintenance_start) AS STRING) AS `Last gap`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE)
GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model ORDER BY `Days out` DESC

panels.title: Gaps of ${tail}
panels.description: Each gap of the selected aircraft (pick it in the Aircraft list at the top), by the day it started.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(maintenance_start AS STRING) AS `Out from`, days_in_maintenance AS `Days out`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Tail_Number = '${tail}'
ORDER BY maintenance_start

panels.title: Gap history of ${tail}
panels.description: Every gap of the selected aircraft in range, newest first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(start_date AS STRING) AS `Flying from`, days_with_flights AS `Days flying`, round(total_hours, 1) AS `Hours flown`, CAST(maintenance_start AS STRING) AS `Out from`,
       CAST(maintenance_end AS STRING) AS `Out to`, days_in_maintenance AS `Days out`
FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model, a.year_mfr, a.seats
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE g.days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} AND coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g WHERE maintenance_start BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Tail_Number = '${tail}'
ORDER BY maintenance_start DESC

panels.title: Hours flown between service gaps: ${tail}
panels.description: An operating period runs from the end of one service gap (a gap of at least the 'Service gap' number of days) to the start of the next; shorter gaps inside it don't end it. Hours are airborne hours (BTS AirTime). Each bar is one period of the selected aircraft, labelled with the day the service gap began; the line is the hour limit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(gap_from AS STRING) AS `Service gap from`,
       CASE WHEN hours <= ${limit_hours} THEN round(hours) END AS `Within limit`, CASE WHEN hours > ${limit_hours} THEN round(hours) END AS `Over limit`
FROM (SELECT Tail_Number, make_model, min(start_date) AS run_from, date_add(max(maintenance_start), -1) AS last_flight,
        datediff(max(maintenance_start), min(start_date)) AS cal_days, sum(days_with_flights) AS flying_days,
        sum(total_hours) AS hours, max(maintenance_start) AS gap_from, max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) AS gap_days,
        min(start_date) = min(first_day) AS first_in_data
   FROM (SELECT g.*, min(start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number) AS first_day,
                coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN days_in_maintenance >= ${min_gap} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY Tail_Number
                         ORDER BY maintenance_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS grp
         FROM (SELECT g.*, date_add(g.maintenance_start, g.days_in_maintenance - 1) AS maintenance_end, coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') AS make_model
      FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_maintenance_gaps g LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info a ON a.tail = g.Tail_Number
      WHERE coalesce(a.make_model, 'Unknown') IN (${model:singlequote})) g)
   GROUP BY Tail_Number, make_model, grp HAVING max_by(days_in_maintenance, maintenance_start) >= ${min_gap}) r WHERE gap_from BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Tail_Number = '${tail}'
ORDER BY gap_from
